objective: Harden DR24 acquisition error reporting, empty and partial batch Workbench handling, export protection, and model dependency provenance while preserving the frozen scientific baseline. Ensure the new deterministic Workbench regression test actually runs on pull requests to main.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: Adds DR24 acquisition exception logging, defensive handling for empty/partial/missing-OID batch responses, export protection, regression assertions, and installed dependency provenance checks.
Corrected the cycle record to use registered metric names and allowed regression status values. The updated CI lifecycle validation passed.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: CI test report artifact 14721108692 from run 44939561094
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: JUnit report confirms 743 passed and 14 skipped. The target Workbench browser test is among the skips because ZTF_DR24_BATCH_UI_TEST was not enabled in the general test suite.

baseline.description: Canonical main branch before PR #300. Frozen v0.2.0 scientific baseline, model artifacts, feature definitions, class order, and acceptance criteria are unchanged.

expected_improvement: Record DR24 acquisition exceptions for diagnosis.
Handle empty, partial, and missing-OID batch responses without misleading UI state.
Prevent JSON export when no usable observations are present.
Compare model dependency provenance with installed environment versions.
Execute the deterministic Playwright Workbench regression test for pull requests targeting main.

robustness.before: The previous Workbench test did not cover empty and partial batch responses, and the opt-in UI test was not triggered by PR #300.
robustness.after: Regression assertions cover partial responses, empty responses, missing OIDs, provenance retention, returned-record export, and disabled export when no records are returned. The dedicated workflow is now configured to run for relevant pull requests to main.
robustness.evidence: The test assertions are present in tests/integration/test_dr24_batch_workbench_ui.py. The general suite on run 44939561094 skipped this opt-in test because the environment flag was not set. The updated workflow requires a fresh run before this regression is considered verified.

scientific_validity.reason: This engineering change does not provide source-backed scientific validation, original model authentication, feature parity, physical-source identity, or full-cohort Park acceptance evidence.

measurement.trade_off: Defensive UI behavior and traceability improve. The DR24 Explorer remains separate from production inference. The workflow change adds a bounded deterministic browser test and does not download survey data.

evidence: CI run 44939561094 passed Format Check, Lint, Cumulative Lifecycle Gate, Test Suite, Runtime Smoke Tests, Build & Verify Package, Dependency Audit, and CI Gate.
The Test Suite reported 743 passed, 14 skipped, 9 warnings, and 84% line coverage in 94.63 seconds.
The JUnit artifact identifies three feature/data integration modules, three opt-in DR24 tests, seven production-inference tests, and one opt-in Zubercal test among the 14 skips.
The specific deterministic Workbench browser test was skipped because ZTF_DR24_BATCH_UI_TEST was not set in the general suite.
Scientific Validation run 44939561107 passed its contract/registry tests, but all four source-backed evidence jobs were skipped. These skips are not scientific passes.
The dedicated Workbench workflow previously filtered pull requests to a legacy feature branch. This update changes its pull_request target to main and retains its path filters; a new run is required.

root_causes: The earlier cycle record failed lifecycle validation because it contained unregistered metric names and an unsupported regression status. Commit 235c3b93ef08fa81df136adc4a001b488f78df73 corrected the record, and the latest lifecycle gate passed.
The new Workbench UI regression test was not executed by the general CI suite because it is opt-in.
The dedicated browser workflow did not trigger for PR #300 because its pull_request target-branch filter pointed to a legacy feature branch rather than main.
unresolved: Verify that the dedicated deterministic Workbench workflow runs on the updated PR head and passes.
Keep the original v0.2.0 production model recovery and dependent inference tests blocked until the original artifact and trusted manifest are available.
Keep source-backed scientific validation separate from engineering CI; the corresponding jobs remain skipped.

findings: A successful aggregate Test Suite does not verify tests that are reported as skipped.
Opt-in tests require an active workflow trigger and explicit environment configuration.
A successful scientific contract job does not imply that source-backed acquisition and benchmark evidence jobs ran.
DR24 Workbench defensive handling must not be represented as production classifier validation.

open_blockers: The targeted Playwright test test_workbench_loads_and_exports_multiple_dr24_oids was skipped in CI run 44939561094. The corrected workflow must execute it on the new PR head.
Seven production-inference tests remain skipped because the original model artifact or shared model inputs are unavailable; tracked in Issue #282.
Three feature/data integration modules remain skipped because their required frozen feature/raw-data inputs are not available in the CI runner.
Four source-backed Scientific Validation jobs were skipped; they remain unverified.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep DR24 acquisition and Workbench diagnostics separate from production inference.
Preserve the frozen v0.2.0 model, feature, taxonomy, class order, and acceptance criteria.
Do not claim scientific validation from skipped source-backed jobs or from engineering CI.
Do not report an opt-in regression test as verified until its dedicated workflow has completed successfully.
Recover and independently authenticate the original production model before enabling production inference.
